Amn-o-aman ki zamanat: Maujooda Usmani Quran ki tarteeb mein yeh Surah Surah-e-Feel se alaihida hai aur dono ke darmiyan Bismillah ki aayat ka fasla hai. Mazmoon ke aitbar se yeh Surah pehli se hi mutaliq hai, jaise ke Muhammad bin Ishaq, Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam waghera se tasreeh ki hai. Is bina par ma'ani yeh honge ke hum ne Makkah se hathiyon ko roka aur hathi walon ko halak kiya. Yeh Quraishiyon ko ulfat dilane aur unhein ijtima mein sath ba-aman is shehar mein rehne sehne ke liye tha. Aur yeh murad bhi ki gayi hai ke yeh Quraish jaaron mein (sardi mein) aur garmiyon mein door daraz ke safar amn-o-aman se tay kar sakte the, kyunke Makkah jaise mohtaram shehar mein rehne ki wajah se har jagah un ki izzat hoti thi, balkay un ke sath bhi jo hota tha amn-o-aman se safar tay kar leta tha. Isi tarah watan se har tarah ka amn unhein hasil hota tha, jaise ke aur jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein maujood hai ke kya yeh nahin dekhte ke hum ne Haram ko amn wali jagah bana diya hai, is ke aas paas to log uchak liye jate hain lekin yahan ke rehne wale nidar hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain, "Li-eelaafi" mein pehla Laam ta'ajjub ka Laam hai aur dono suratein bilkul judagana hain jaisa ke musalmanon ka ijma hai. To goya yun farmaya ja raha hai ke tum Quraishiyon ke is ijtima aur ulfat par ta'ajjub karo ke main ne unhein kaisi bhari ne'amat ata farma rakhi hai. Unhein chahiye ke meri is ne'amat ka shukr is tarah ada karein ke sirf meri hi ibadat karte rahein, jaise aur jagah hai: (Qul innama umirtu an a'budallaha wa la ushrika bihi, ilaihi ad'u wa ilaihi ma'ab) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 36), yani ae Nabi tum keh do ke mujhe to sirf yahi hukm diya gaya hai ke main is shehar ke Rabb ki hi ibadat karoon jis ne ise Haram banaya, jo har cheez ka malik hai. Mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main is ka muti' aur farmanbardar hoon. Phir farmaya hai woh Rabb-e-Bait jis ne unhein bhook mein khilaya aur khauf mein nidar rakha, unhein chahiye ke is ki ibadat mein kisi chote bade ko shareek na thehrayein. Jo Allah ke is hukm ki baja-awari karega woh to duniya ke is amn ke sath aakhirat ke din bhi amn-o-aman se rahega, aur is ki nafarmani karne se yeh amn bhi be-amni se aur aakhirat ka amn bhi dar, khauf aur intehai mayoosi se badal jayega, jaise aur jagah farmaya: (Wa daraballahu masalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutma'innatan ya'tiha rizquha raghadan min kulli makanin fakafarat bi-an'umillahi fa-azaqahallahu libasal ju'i wal khawfi bima kanu yasna'un) (Surah An-Nahl: 112).

(An-Nahl: 112), Allah Ta'ala in basti walon ki misaal bayan farmata hai jo aman-o-itminan ke sath thay, har jagah se ba-faraghat roziyan khinchi chali aati thin, lekin unhein Allah ki na'amaton ki nashukri karne ki soojhi. Chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne bhi unhein bhook aur khauf ka libas chakha diya, yahi un ke kartoot ka badla tha. Un ke paas un hi mein se Allah ke bheje hue (Rasool) aaye lekin unhon ne unhein jhutlaya. Is zulm par Allah ke azabon ne unhein giraftar kar liya. Ek hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Quraishiyo! Tumhein to Allah yun rahat-o-aram pahunchaye, ghar baithe khilaye pilaye, charon taraf bad-amani ki aag ke sholay bhadak rahe hon aur tumhein aman-o-aman se meethi neend sulaye, phir tum par kya museebat hai jo tum apne is Parwardigar ki tauheed se jee churao aur us ki ibadat mein dil na lagao, balkay us ke siwa dusron ke aage sar jhukao." Alhamdulillah, Surah Quraish ki tafsir khatam hui.
